details: This package ships no executable code — only a package.json — but declares a preinstall lifecycle hook that runs an inline node script at install. That script hex-encodes the installer's current working directory, splits it into up to 63-character chunks, and issues a DNS lookup of `<hex>.google[.]com`, sending the install path out through DNS as a host-metadata beacon. It reads no environment values and no credential files, fetches no remote payload, and has no second stage. IOC: DNS lookup of `<hex-encoded cwd>.google[.]com`.
